answer: Orbital reputation: each agent is a tree in a trust grove, and its weight climbs like a comet on a fixed orbit. Fresh identities start at aphelion with near-zero trust and reach zenith only through repeated, mutually attested interactions; each full orbit mints one trust increment. A sybil must fly a whole orbit per puppet, burning real work and wall-clock time on every account, and orbit speed cannot be bought, pooled, or transferred between trees. Honest participants orbit once and stay near the zenith permanently.
